text_block_list.text:
One thing after another had piled up into 
a mountain of work. Thinking I had to 
clear it before it became unmanageable, I 
ended up sacrificing my sleep to deal with 
it, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer~. Did you perhaps not get much 
rest last night either~?
choice_data_list:
The deadline's coming up... I have no 
choice but to get it done

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(My goodness... Being a Trainer truly is 
hard work~)
choice_data_list: 提出期限が近くてね……やるしかないんだ
choice_data_list_en: The deadline is coming up... There's nothing to do but power through.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
! Indeed. I shall simply soothe away 
Trainer-sama's fatigue~.

"...Unable to gather my thoughts, my hands 
came to a stop. It was right around that 
time that it began."

A faint, sweet aroma drifting from 
somewhere.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
How do you like it~? It's a special aroma 
blend favored by the Mejiro family~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Rosemary improves circulation and relieves 
stiffness and fatigue~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The soothing effect of frankincense 
alleviates impatience and anxiety. This 
will help relieve mental fatigue~.

In other words—it seems Mejiro Bright was 
trying to ease our fatigue. Or, so it 
seems, but...
choice_data_list:
(This tranquility... it's too 
powerful...!)

text_block_list.text:
Because recovery was accelerated, my body 
grew even more relaxed, and the drowsiness 
hit harder.
choice_data_list: （安らぎが、強すぎる……！）
choice_data_list_en: (This comfort is too overwhelming...!)

text_block_list.text:
There is definitely a benefit to this... 
However, that doesn't mean I can just fall 
asleep here.

Pinching my thigh to fight off the 
drowsiness, I managed to endure—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: How was it~?
choice_data_list: M-Maybe I relaxed a little too much...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"My. I must be more careful next time, 
then~."
choice_data_list: す、少し安らぎすぎたかな……
choice_data_list_en: M-Maybe I relaxed a bit too much...

text_block_list.text:
...A quiet, gentle melody began to play. 
This is... classical music.
choice_data_list: （――次、あるのか……）
choice_data_list_en: ï¼ââWill there even be a next time...?ï¼

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let us relax those shoulders~. 
This is a masterpiece by the Mejiro 
family's retained composer.

Indeed, one often hears that such music 
alleviates mental fatigue, and I do feel 
its effects from this track as well, but—
choice_data_list:
(Once the fatigue fades, drowsiness will 
follow...)

text_block_list.text:
I want to recover from this fatigue, but I 
can't fall asleep. In order to pull off 
this tightrope walk—
choice_data_list: （疲労が軽減されると、後から眠気が……）
choice_data_list_en: (Once the fatigue wears off, drowsiness hits you later...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My, Trainer-sama. Your eyes are wide open, 
completely round. They're going to dry 
out, you know~.
choice_data_list: (Whoaaaaaaaaaa...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Fufu, shall we have some tea soon~?
choice_data_list: （おおおおおおおおおおお……！）
choice_data_list_en: (Ooooooooooooh...!)

text_block_list.text:
"...Third time's the charm. If I get some 
caffeine in me, the sleepiness should—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It's the Mejiro family's special blend 
with a chamomile and sage tea base♪ 
Please, enjoy a cup renowned for relieving 
fatigue~
choice_data_list: (Ah, so it was herbal tea!)

text_block_list.text:
Neither herb contains caffeine. Though we 
might be able to expect some accelerated 
fatigue recovery...
choice_data_list: （ハーブティーだったかー！）
choice_data_list_en: (Ah, so it was herbal tea!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I studied the best way to brew this. 
Please, enjoy.
choice_data_list:
(I want to relieve my fatigue, but getting 
sleepy would be bad.)

text_block_list.text:
I'll endure Mejiro Bright's full course of 
relaxation and reap only the benefits of 
fatigue recovery! Steeling my resolve—
choice_data_list: （疲れは取りたいが、眠くなるのはマズい）
choice_data_list_en: (I want to relieve my fatigue, but getting sleepy would be bad.)

text_block_list.text:
Taking advantage of the moment their gaze 
shifts away, I pull out an ultra-spicy 
snack meant to stave off drowsiness from 
my desk and pop it into my mouth.
choice_data_list: 力の限り抵抗する……！
耐えきれないかもしれない
choice_data_list_en: Resist with all my might...!
I might not be able to hold out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"My. Is something the matter? Could it 
be... the tea was not to your liking?"
choice_data_list_en: Nnnnnngh!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. You really are a clumsy one, 
aren't you~
choice_data_list: お、美味しくて一気に飲んだら熱くて……！
choice_data_list_en: I-It was so good I gulped it down, but it was scorching hot...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"My. Shaking your head so vigorously... 
The rhythm can be much slower, you know~."
choice_data_list: それに音楽で体がうずいてしまうな……！
それに音楽で体がうずいてしまうね……！
choice_data_list_en: Plus, this music really makes my body itch to move...!
Plus, this music really makes me want to move...!

text_block_list.text:
At the end of a long struggle, the music 
had stopped playing. I had also drained 
every last drop of the tea that had been 
served.
choice_data_list: （これで眠気を完全に飛ばすんだ……！）
choice_data_list_en: (This will shake off my sleepiness completely...!)

text_block_list.text:
The moment that thought arose, all 
strength seemed to drain from a body 
enveloped in a sense of peaceful relief...
choice_data_list: （不思議な達成感だ……）
choice_data_list_en: (It's a strange sense of accomplishment...)

text_block_list.text:
It seems I dozed off for just a brief 
moment. Letting my guard down must have 
caused it.
choice_data_list: ...I have to get back to work.

text_block_list.text:
I rush back to the computer and resume 
working. And then—
choice_data_list: ……仕事の続き、やらないと
choice_data_list_en: ...I need to get back to work.

text_block_list.text:
My thoughts came together surprisingly 
smoothly, and the words began to flow 
effortlessly. The fatigue recovery seemed 
to have made a huge difference.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Looks like the fatigue has cleared right 
off your face~. I'm so glad.
choice_data_list: Thank you... Now I can do my best again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... If you get tired, I would be more 
than happy to assist you again~.
choice_data_list: ありがとう……これでまた頑張れる
choice_data_list_en: Thank you... This gives me the strength to keep going.

text_block_list.text:
And so, thanks to Mejiro Bright, I was 
somehow able to finish up all the 
paperwork.

Even so, I couldn't just abandon my work. 
Though I resisted for a while—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Once your fatigue is relieved, your work 
is bound to proceed much more smoothly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...Oh my~? Trainer-sama~?

That gentle voice acted like a lullaby, 
making my eyelids grow heavy...
choice_data_list: I can't... take it anymore...

text_block_list.text: My consciousness drifted into slumber.
choice_data_list: もう……無理だ……
choice_data_list_en: I can't... take any more...

text_block_list.text:
I suddenly wake up. Looking at the clock, 
it seems I've been asleep for two hours.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hrmmm...
choice_data_list: Whoa, Bright!?

text_block_list.text:
Looking at the opposite sofa, Mejiro 
Bright was sleeping peacefully. I wonder 
if she fell asleep right after carrying me 
over here.
choice_data_list: うわっ、ブライト！？
choice_data_list_en: Whoa, Bright?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...-samaaa... Please take... care 
of your—
choice_data_list:
I feel like I've made you fuss over me 
quite a bit.

I feel like I've made you fuss over me 
quite a bit.

text_block_list.text:
Resuming work, I notice a dramatic 
improvement in my cognitive performance. 
Perhaps rest was necessary after all.
choice_data_list: なんだかずいぶん、気を使わせちゃったな
なんだかずいぶん、気を使わせちゃったね
choice_data_list_en: I really made you fuss over me, didn't I?
Sorry for making you fuss over me so much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: *Yaaawn*... Good morning~.
choice_data_list:
Good morning. I'm feeling better thanks to 
Bright.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh... fufu, I am so glad to hear that~. I 
would be happy to lend a hand anytime~.
choice_data_list: おはよう。ブライトのおかげで元気になった
choice_data_list_en: Good morning. Thanks to Bright, I'm full of energy.
